title: Micah's Lament over the Cities of Judah
description: The prophet Micah laments and mourns over the cities of Judah that are struck by God's judgment. He mentions Gath, Beth-leaphrah, Shaphir, Saanannim, Beth-ezel, Maroth, Lachish, Moresheth-gath, Achzib, Mareshah, and Adullam, and calls for mourning, flight, and shaving the head because of the children who are taken into captivity.
